cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Prove We’re Close
cards.instruction: Get someone to take a social or emotional risk that demonstrates trust in the connection.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before you send another 'fine,' tell me what you deleted. I want us to trust each other with the awkward version. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Let me be the person you can sound needy with.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You first. You always sound so casual.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I check whether you've replied before I get out of bed. Will you send me your needy bit now?

mechanism: A confidently directs an honest exchange but takes the first emotional risk when B makes reciprocity the price of participation.
confusable: Unlike only comforting B, A seeks a risky disclosure as trust proof; borrowed authority surrenders sequence and polished presentation to keep B engaged.
comparison: Private message vulnerability differs from public couple identification after a prior retreat.
seedUse: Use D80-b deleted message/needy/casual/first-morning check with S02-a reframing B requested order as A plan.
